console.title: Staff console
console.noQueues: This location has no queues yet. An admin can add one under Queue setup.
console.onlineJoinsPaused: Online joins paused: this queue reached its hourly limit. Add walk-ins here. Online joins reopen around {{time}}.

counter.label: My counter
counter.hint: Pick where you serve from. This tablet remembers it.

empty.no_show: No no-shows in the last two hours.

intake.title: Intake answers
intake.stale: This visit changed. Close the sheet and try again.
intake.failed: That did not save. Try again.

error.title: Couldn't load the list
error.body: The console keeps trying every 30 seconds.

status.paused: Paused: no new guests for now

explain.open: Pause for a short break, or close when you are done for the day.
explain.paused: The join page asks people to check back soon. Everyone already waiting keeps their place.
explain.closed: The join page says the queue is closed until you open it again. Everyone already waiting stays in line until you serve or remove them.

controls.closeDescription: No one new can join until you open it again. Guests already waiting stay in line. Pause instead if this is a short break.

error.org_suspended: This business is suspended, so the queue can’t change. Contact support.
error.unknown: Couldn’t change the queue. Check the connection and try again.

console.stale: Someone else just changed this guest. The list is up to date now.
console.actionFailed: That didn't go through. Try again.

no_show.title: Mark {{ticket}} as a no-show?
no_show.body: They leave the line. You can reinstate them for the next two hours.

remove.title: Remove {{ticket}} from the line?
remove.body: They lose their place. The reason is kept with the visit.
remove.reasonHint: Required. For example: asked to leave, duplicate ticket.

retryBlocked.opted_out: This guest opted out of texts, so it can't be sent again.
retryBlocked.no_consent: This guest hasn't agreed to texts, so it can't be sent again.

addGuest.title: Add a guest to {{queue}}
addGuest.name: Name (optional)
addGuest.nameHint: First name is enough. Staff call them by it.
addGuest.phoneHint: For a text when it is their turn.

attest.v1: The guest agreed to receive texts about this visit
attest.hint: Leave this unticked if they did not. They can still wait in line without texts.
attest.optedOut: This number has opted out of texts. Visit added; texts are off.
attest.offline: Visit saved offline; texts are off.

notAccepting.closed: This queue is closed. Open it before adding guests.
notAccepting.paused: This queue is paused. Resume it before adding guests.
notAccepting.outside_hours: This queue is outside its opening hours, so it is not taking guests.
notAccepting.full: This queue is full right now.
notAccepting.org_suspended: This business is suspended, so queues are not taking guests.
notAccepting.other: This queue is not taking guests right now.

error.invalid_input: Check the name, party size and number.
error.unknown: Couldn't add the guest. Check the connection and try again.

addGuest.phoneInvalid: That isn't a full mobile number. Fix it, or clear it to add the guest without texts.

console.undone: Undone: {{ticket}} is back where they were.
console.undoTooLate: Can't undo {{ticket}} any more: something changed since.

scan.title: Scan a guest's QR
scan.description: Hold the guest's QR code in front of the camera, or type the code under it.
scan.failed: That didn't go through. Try again.
scan.notOnList: Found, but this guest is not on today's list.

camera.denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow the camera for this site in your browser settings, or type the code instead.
camera.none: No camera was found on this device. Type the code instead.
camera.failed: The camera could not start. Type the code instead.

timeline.label: Today's timeline
timeline.empty: Nothing is scheduled or waiting today.

sound.gate: Sound is off. Tap below to hear a chime when someone joins.
sound.on: Sound on: a chime plays when someone joins.
sound.muteSwitch: Didn't hear the test chime? Check the volume, and on iPad turn off the side mute switch or Silent mode.

console.suspended: This business is suspended, so the queue can’t change. Contact support.

broadcast.title: Message everyone in {{name}}
broadcast.description: Sends one text to every guest who is waiting or has been called.
broadcast.hint: {{ticket}} and {{eta_range}} are filled in for each guest.
broadcast.quickLate: We're running about 15 minutes behind. Thank you for waiting.
broadcast.quickBreak: We're taking a short break and will be back soon.
broadcast.quickNear: Please stay close by: we'll call you soon.
broadcast.confirmNote: Guests who turned this alert off, or have no way to be reached, are skipped. You can't unsend it.

error.rate_limited: Too many messages to this queue in the last hour. Try again later.
error.unknown_variable: That message uses a placeholder that doesn't exist.
error.invalid_input: Write a message of 1 to 320 characters.
error.org_suspended: This business is suspended, so messages can't be sent.
error.unknown: The message was not sent. Try again.

broadcast.historyEmpty: Nothing sent in the last 24 hours.

reorder.instructions: To reorder, press space, then the arrow keys, then space again to drop. Escape cancels.
reorder.cancelled: Reorder cancelled. {{ticket}} stays where it was.

contact.whatsappText: Hi, this is about your place in line, ticket {{ticket}}.
contact.noPhone: This guest left no phone number.
contact.failed: Could not open WhatsApp. Try again.

detail.title: Details for {{ticket}}
detail.privacy: Staff only. Do not enter health details.

block.title: Remove and block {{ticket}}?
block.body: The visit is removed. Their phone, email and device can't join any queue of this business until the block ends. You can lift it under Blocks.
block.reasonHint: Your team sees this on the block list.
block.nothing: This visit has no phone, email or device to block, so nothing was changed.

history.title: History of {{ticket}}
history.error: The history could not be loaded. Try again.

editTimes.title: Edit times of {{ticket}}
editTimes.hint: Times are on this location's clock. Leave a time alone to keep it.

error.order: Times must run in order: joined, called, started, finished.
error.future: A time can't be in the future.
error.invalid_times: Those times don't fit this visit. Check the order.
error.permission_denied: Only managers, or the person who handled this visit today, can correct its times.
error.stale_visit: This visit changed. Close this and try again.
error.unknown: The correction was not saved. Try again.

search.label: Search guests
search.hint: Name, ticket or the last digits of a phone number.
search.error: The search failed. Try again in a moment.

transfer.title: Transfer {{ticket}}
transfer.place: The guest keeps their place by join time, and their status link keeps working.
transfer.serviceHint: Pick the service they need in the other queue.
transfer.notAccepting: That queue isn't taking guests right now.

assign.title: Assign {{ticket}}
assign.hint: The guest stays on everyone's list, but only that person's or counter's Call next picks them.
assign.notCovered: That person or counter can't take this guest.

waitOverride.title: Current wait for {{name}}
waitOverride.hint: Guests are told this wait until it runs out, instead of the usual estimate.
waitOverride.active: Wait set to about {{minutes}} min until {{time}}
waitOverride.error: The wait was not saved. Try again.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Single keys act on the selected guest. They are ignored while you type or a dialog is open.

offline.saved: Saved offline: {{ticket}} will update when you are back online.
offline.addSaved: Saved offline: {{name}} will be added when you are back online.
offline.unavailable: This browser can't store actions offline. Anything you do now needs a connection, so check the Wi-Fi before you continue.
offline.needsConnection: You are offline. Actions on a guest are saved and sent when the connection returns. Calling the next guest and changing the queue state need a connection.

review.title_one: Needs review: {{count}} saved action was not applied
review.title_other: Needs review: {{count}} saved actions were not applied
review.nowIn: Another tablet changed this guest. They are now {{state}}.
review.gone: Another tablet finished or removed this guest, so the action can't be applied.
review.addRefused: The queue refused this guest when you came back online.
review.discardBody: It will never be sent. The guest stays as they are now.

partyEditor.title: People with this guest
partyEditor.stale: This visit changed. Close and reopen the details, then try again.
partyEditor.failed: Couldn't save the party. Try again.

priority.title: Priority for {{ticket}}
priority.hint: Moves the guest ahead of those who joined shortly before them. A guest you moved by hand keeps their place.
priority.failed: Couldn't set the priority. The guest may have been called.

messages.title: Messages
messages.none: No messages were sent for this visit.
messages.notRelevant: Too late to retry: the guest has moved on.
messages.failedIntro: Messages from the last day that did not reach a guest. Call them out loud, or retry a dead one.

reason.no_consent: The guest has not agreed to this channel.
reason.suppressed: The guest opted out of this channel.
reason.no_channel: This channel is not set up.
reason.recipient_deleted: The guest's device is no longer registered.
reason.hard_bounce: The address does not accept mail.
reason.complaint: The guest reported it as spam.

chat.title: Chat with the guest
chat.disabled: Chat is turned off for this queue.

planning.title: Planning
planning.error: Couldn't load the planning grid. Try again.
planning.noResources: This location has no resources yet. An admin can add them under Resources.
planning.hint: To block time, drag across the grid, or use the arrow keys to move, Shift plus arrows to select and Enter to confirm.

block.title: Block time
block.conflicts_one: {{count}} booking overlaps this time. It stays booked; contact the guest if needed.
block.conflicts_other: {{count}} bookings overlap this time. They stay booked; contact the guests if needed.

error.failed: Couldn't block that time. Try again.

planning.nothing: Nothing is booked, blocked or scheduled on this day.

presence.label: Your status
presence.failed: Couldn't change your status. Try again.
presence.callDisabled: You're on break. Set yourself to Available to call the next guest.
